topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: It was a typical morning, the kind where the sun filters through the blinds in that familiar, gentle way. I settled into my desk, the room buzzing with the quiet hum of early arrivals. Just as I opened the day's lesson plan, there was a soft knock at the door. A young man, now taller, more composed, stood there with a small, wrapped box. It was Michael, a student from years back. He handed me the gift, his smile shy but warm. "Thank you," he said, simply. Unwrapping it, I found a beautifully bound book of classic short stories, a note inside reading, "For the teacher who made me love literature. With gratitude." The weight of the gift felt just right in my hands, a perfect start to the day.
